notes.title: Bugfix release
notes.content:
A new version is available:
- No longer need to block all shots to complete a difficulty
- Upgrade from Unreal 4.12 to 4.14
- Fix attempt for 'head stuck in the ground with Oculus Rift'

Known issues:
- the VR mirror screen is incredibly blurry since the upgrade to Unreal 4.14. I found a workaround though that involves recompiling the engine. Will give it a try in the next days.

tags.bug: - Fix attempt for 'head stuck in the ground with Oculus Rift'

notes.title: Small bugfix update
notes.content:
Hey there,

thanks for your feedback on the Desert Temple update! I just released a bugfix update, to smooth things out a little bit:

- Blade master enemy now throws stones in a reliable way at you
- Hotfix for bad performance on 4k displays
- The game waits a little bit before spawning the first drone
- The drone plays a sound when it spawns


Have fun!

notes.title: Desert Temple released
notes.content:
The Desert Temple update is out now!

To access the temple, you need to select the new menu item 'extras' and choose 'desert temple'.

Have fun!!!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25179063/0409d748f1c53146be8ea37e6d9f85282b3638bb.png[/img]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25179063/b932d253ebdbcea05948b8a0b71dd00f86df7424.png[/img]

Bugfixes:
- Render target multiplier should no longer slow down framerate

notes.title: Small update
notes.content:
Hey there!

thank you so much for all the feedback and suggestions! I just uploaded a small update to the game, which fixes a few minor things:

- blades 'clash' now against each other
- blades are less bright
- a framerate issue that caused the lasers to be way too slow on some devices should be fixed now

I will start work on a new level on the upcoming weekend, so stay tuned :-)

tags.bug: - a framerate issue that caused the lasers to be way too slow on some devices should be fixed now
